description: Save, list, or forget scoped memories that Dispatch injects into the next start_job prompt. Scope is job, repo, or user. Does not auto-save code-changing rules; those need confirm=true. Call when the user says remember this, forget that, or list memories.

confirm.description: Required when the text looks like a code-changing rule

path.description: Optional workspace-relative file this memory is about

symbol.description: Optional symbol name this memory is about (M-075)

text.description: Memory text for add, or search text for forget

name: remember
title: Remember for next jobs
